description: Capture the raw SAY/SPEAK character span after the parser resets its ordinary numeric state, reusing dormant parser globals for the lifetime of the SAY action, and split natural question/exclamation punctuation cleanly

replacements.new:
<COND (<AND <G? ,P-LEN 1>
		    <OR <EQUAL? .WRD ,W?SAY>
			<EQUAL? .WRD ,W?SPEAK>>>
	       <SET SPTR <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .PTR ,P-LEXELEN> 7>>>
	       <SET LPTR <+ .PTR <* <- ,P-LEN 1> ,P-LEXELEN>>>
	       <SET EPTR <+ <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .LPTR 2> 3>>
			    <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .LPTR 2> 2>>>>
	       <SETG P-ADVERB .SPTR>
	       <SETG P-NUMBER <- .EPTR .SPTR>>
	       <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 1>
	       <SETG P-LEN 1>)>
